_note: Episode Generator PRD §5: 'Source catalogue. Config file: source, API, license, language, topics. Only licensed or API sources. No scraping.' This is that config file, loaded by app/services/source_catalogue.seed_source_catalogue on every boot (insert-if-domain-missing, never overwrites an existing row — see that function's docstring). No team was available to curate the launch catalogue in this session (PRD open question: 'Which sources in the catalogue at launch, and who maintains it?' is still unresolved) — these are a reasonable, genuinely real starter set: each entry documents in `notes` why it plausibly qualifies as a licensed or API source, not scraped. Replace/expand with whatever the team actually negotiates or licenses before relying on this list as a real compliance record. IMPORTANT — this catalogue is a provenance/licensing label attached AFTER the fact to whatever Claude's web_search tool returns; it does not and cannot restrict web_search to only these domains (see app/models/source_catalogue.py's module docstring for why).

sources.name: SEC EDGAR (full-text search & company facts APIs)
sources.notes: efts.sec.gov / data.sec.gov are documented, free, self-serve REST APIs over official filings. US federal government works carry no copyright, so republishing facts drawn from them is not scraping-under-a-ban, it's a public API over public-domain data.

sources.name: Federal Reserve Economic Data (FRED) API
sources.license_name: Public domain (Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis, free registration API key)
sources.notes: api.stlouisfed.org is a documented REST/JSON API requiring only a free API key; FRED's own terms explicitly permit redistribution with attribution.

sources.name: World Bank Open Data API
sources.notes: api.worldbank.org is a free, keyless, documented REST API; World Bank open data is explicitly published under CC BY-4.0.

sources.name: European Central Bank Statistical Data Warehouse (SDW) API
sources.license_name: ECB Data Portal reuse policy (free reuse with attribution)
sources.notes: The ECB's SDW/Data Portal exposes a documented REST API (SDMX) for exchange rates, rates and monetary statistics, published for free reuse.

sources.name: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics Public Data API
sources.notes: api.bls.gov is a documented public REST API (v2 requires a free registration key) over US federal statistics.

sources.name: NASA open APIs (api.nasa.gov)
sources.license_name: US Government Work (public domain), free API key
sources.notes: api.nasa.gov is a documented, free, keyed REST API aggregating NASA open data (APOD, near-Earth objects, etc.).

sources.name: NOAA Climate Data Online (CDO) API
sources.license_name: US Government Work (public domain), free API token
sources.notes: www.ncdc.noaa.gov/cdo-web/webservices/v2 is a documented free REST API for NOAA's climate datasets.

sources.name: Associated Press Content API
sources.license_name: AP Content API commercial license agreement (per-use/subscription — not yet negotiated by Lucaku)
sources.notes: AP sells a documented REST Content API for its wire feed, but it requires a signed commercial license/subscription we have not purchased yet. Left inactive (not matched/used for license attribution) until that agreement exists — listed here so the catalogue shows the real intended news-wire source, not a fabricated 'already licensed' status.

sources.name: GDELT Project API
sources.license_name: GDELT terms of use (free for research/analysis, attribution requested)
sources.notes: api.gdeltproject.org is a free, documented, keyless REST API over GDELT's global news-monitoring index (an aggregation/index product, not a paywalled wire, and not scraped by us — GDELT does the ingestion under its own terms).

sources.name: Wikimedia REST API (Wikipedia)
sources.notes: en.wikipedia.org/api/rest_v1 (and per-language equivalents) is a documented, free REST API; Wikipedia article text is licensed CC BY-SA 4.0.

sources.name: NewsAPI.org
sources.license_name: NewsAPI.org Terms (Developer tier is non-commercial only; commercial use requires a paid Business plan — not yet purchased by Lucaku)
sources.notes: Documented aggregation API over many publishers, but its free tier's terms explicitly forbid production/commercial use. Left inactive until a paid Business-tier subscription is in place — including it inactive keeps the catalogue honest about a source we plausibly want but have not actually licensed for production yet.

sources.name: Financial Modeling Prep API
sources.license_name: Financial Modeling Prep API Terms of Service (paid tier for commercial redistribution)
sources.notes: Documented REST API for market/company financial data with a paid commercial-use tier; genuinely API-delivered, not scraped off a finance site.
